rationale: Session HITL approval is recorded without approver identity for the bounded receipt-v2 provider condition. Mutation is limited to .agents/schemas/multiagent-dispatch-receipt-v2.schema.json to require process_or_session_id when provider is agy, require the timestamp Z suffix, retain Codex compatibility, and leave receipt-v1 unchanged. No dispatcher, policy, template, test, external retry, deploy, publish, push, credential, secret, account, or raw-PII action is authorized.
